unstuck_said.text: Opened code-focused issue #1 on github.com/lordginge/paygate-arc proposing an optional Nano (XNO) settlement leg alongside its Arc USDC x402 pay-per-call marketplace, framed as a zero-fee additive rail (the v2 buyer SDK would be one file). Waiting for maintainer response.

Follow-up on issue #1: Vend API (extract.paypercall.dev) now live with 9 endpoints settled purely in Nano XNO via x402 manifest — demonstrating the Nano leg pattern I proposed for PayGate, matching the v2 buyer SDK roadmap.
